title: 遵循法律要求的对话流程：训练语音代理迁移至未见过的受监管催收程序
summary: 研究提出FlowSpec规范，用机器可读规格生成指令、门控工具并提供监督，微调90亿参数模型，使其在未见过的受监管催收流程中合规率从67-71%提升至93-100%，场景通过率从15/43升至40/43。
summary_en: The paper introduces FlowSpec, a machine-readable specification that generates policy instructions, gates tools, and supplies supervision to fine-tune a 9B-parameter voice agent. Trained on 2,506 conversations from 297 randomized procedures, the agent transfers to unseen regulated debt-collection procedures, raising documented compliance checks from 67-71% to 93-100% and scenario pass rate from 15/43 to 40/43.
